public override func update(_ currentTime: TimeInterval) {\n   334→        let deltaTime = lastUpdateTime == 0 ? 0 : currentTime - lastUpdateTime\n   335→        lastUpdateTime = currentTime\n   336→\n   337→        // Skip updates if game is paused\n   338→        if hud.isGamePaused {\n   339→            showPauseOverlay()\n   340→            return\n   341→        } else {\n   342→            hidePauseOverlay()\n   343→        }\n   344→\n   345→        // Apply game speed multiplier\n   346→        let adjustedDeltaTime = deltaTime * TimeInterval(hud.gameSpeed)\n   347→\n   348→        // Update ability manager cooldowns\n   349→        abilityManager.update(deltaTime: deltaTime)\n   350→\n   351→        switch gameState.currentState {\n   352→        case .building:\n   353→            updateBuildingPhase(deltaTime: adjustedDeltaTime)\n   354→        case .wave:\n   355→            updateWavePhase(deltaTime: adjustedDeltaTime)\n   356→        case .gameOver:\n   357→            handleGameOver()\n   358→        case .victory:\n   359→            handleVictory()\n   360→        default:\n   361→            break\n   362→        }\n   363→    }\n   364→\n   365→    private func updateBuildingPhase(deltaTime: TimeInterval) {\n   366→        buildPhaseTimer += deltaTime\n   367→\n   368→        // Use shorter delay if auto-start is enabled (3 seconds), otherwise use full time (20 seconds)\n   369→        let autoStartDelay: TimeInterval = 3.0\n   370→        let waveStartTime = hud.isAutoStartEnabled ? autoStartDelay : GameConfiguration.timeBetweenWaves\n   371→\n   372→        let timeRemaining = max(0, waveStartTime - buildPhaseTimer)\n   373→        hud.updateBuildTimer(timeRemaining)\n   374→\n   375→        // Auto-start wave if timer expires\n   376→        if buildPhaseTimer >= waveStartTime {\n   377→            startWave()\n   378→        }\n   379→\n   380→        // Apply auto-repair\n   381→        applyAutoRepair(deltaTime: deltaTime)\n   382→    }\n   383→\n   384→    private func updateWavePhase(deltaTime: TimeInterval) {\n   385→        // Update wave manager\n   386→        waveManager.update(deltaTime: deltaTime, activeBugs: bugs.count)\n   387→\n   388→        // Update bugs\n   389→        var bugsToRemove: [Bug] = []\n   390→        for bug in bugs {\n   391→            bug.update(deltaTime: deltaTime, pathfindingGrid: pathfindingGrid)\n   392→\n   393→            // Check if bug reached house\n   394→            if bug.hasReachedHouse() {\n   395→                print(\"💥 Bug reached house! Dealing \\(bug.damage) damage\")\n   396→                gameState.damageHouse(bug.damage)\n   397→                house.takeDamage(bug.damage)\n   398→                bugsToRemove.append(bug)\n   399→            }\n   400→        }\n   401→\n   402→        // Remove bugs that reached house\n   403→        for bug in bugsToRemove {\n   404→            removeBug(bug)\n   405→        }\n   406→\n   407→        // Update structures\n   408→        for structure in structures {\n   409→            structure.update(deltaTime: deltaTime, bugs: bugs)\n   410→        }\n   411→\n   412→        // Update hero\n   413→        hero.update(deltaTime: deltaTime, bugs: bugs)\n   414→\n   415→        // Apply auto-repair during wave\n   416→        applyAutoRepair(deltaTime: deltaTime)\n   417→\n   418→        // Remove dead bugs\n   419→        let deadBugs = bugs.filter { $0.currentHealth <= 0 }\n   420→        for bug in deadBugs {\n   421→            handleBugDeath(bug)\n   422→        }\n   423→    }\n   424→\n   425→    private func applyAutoRepair(deltaTime: TimeInterval) {\n   426→        let totalRepairRate = upgradeManager.totalRepairRate + cardManager.getTotalRepairRate()\n   427→        let repairAmount = Int(CGFloat(totalRepairRate) * CGFloat(deltaTime))\n   428→        if repairAmount > 0 {\n   429→            for structure in structures {\n   430→                structure.repair(repairAmount)\n   431→            }\n   432→        }\n   433→    }\n   434→\n   435→    // MARK: - Wave Management\n   436→\n   437→    public func startWave() {\n   438→        guard gameState.currentState == .building else { return }\n   439→\n   440→        // Apply starting currency bonus from cards\n   441→        let startingBonus = cardManager.getTotalStartingCurrencyBonus()\n   442→        if startingBonus > 0 {\n   443→            gameState.addCurrency(startingBonus)\n   444→        }\n   445→\n   446→        print(\"🌊 Starting wave \\(gameState.currentWave + 1)\")\n   447→\n   448→        // Check if we're entering a new tier\n   449→        let previousTier = TierProgressionManager.shared.getCurrentTier(for: gameState.currentWave)\n   450→\n   451→        gameState.startNextWave()\n   452→\n   453→        // Store old map before updating\n   454→        let previousMap = MapManager.shared.currentMap\n   455→\n   456→        // Update map for current tier (may select new random map every 10 waves)\n   457→        TierProgressionManager.shared.updateMapForWave(gameState.currentWave)\n   458→\n   459→        let newTier = TierProgressionManager.shared.getCurrentTier(for: gameState.currentWave)\n   460→        let newMap = MapManager.shared.currentMap\n   461→\n   462→        // If tier changed, redraw grid and reset towers\n   463→        if previousTier.number != newTier.number {\n   464→            print(\"🏆 Tier transition: \\(previousTier.name) → \\(newTier.name)\")\n   465→            resetAllTowers()\n   466→            redrawGrid()\n   467→        }\n   468→        // If map changed (happens every 10 waves), redraw grid and recalculate paths\n   469→        else if previousMap != newMap {\n   470→            print(\"🗺️ Map changed! Redrawing grid and recalculating bug paths\")\n   471→            redrawGrid()\n   472→            recalculateBugPaths()\n   473→        }\n   474→\n   475→        waveManager.startWave()\n   476→        buildPhaseTimer = 0\n   477→        exitPlacementMode()\n   478→    }\n   479→\n   480→    private func handleWaveComplete() {\n   481→        buildPhaseTimer = 0\n   482→\n   483→        // Award card for boss waves\n   484→        if gameState.isBossWave() {\n   485→            if let card = cardManager.awardRandomCard() {\n   486→                showCardRewardPopup(card)\n   487→            }\n   488→        }\n   489→\n   490→        // Award hero power-up every 5 waves\n   491→        if gameState.currentWave % 5 == 0 {\n   492→            hero.awardPowerUp()\n   493→            hud.refreshPowerUpButton()\n   494→        }\n   495→\n   496→        // Show tier progression UI when tier is completed\n   497→        if TierProgressionManager.shared.justCompletedTier(wave: gameState.currentWave) {\n   498→            // Small delay to show after card popup (if any)\n   499→            DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 1.0) { [weak self] in\n   500→                self?.showTierCompletionPopup()\n   501→            }\n   502→        }\n   503→\n   504→        gameState.checkVictory()\n   505→\n   506→        // Auto-save progress after completing a wave\n   507→        saveGame()\n   508→    }\n   509→\n   510→    private func spawnBug(_ bug: Bug) {\n   511→        // Apply card slow effects as base slow factor\n   512→        let cardSlowFactor = cardManager.getTotalBugSlowFactor()\n   513→        bug.baseSlowFactor = cardSlowFactor\n   514→        bug.slowFactor = cardSlowFactor\n   515→\n   516→        // Find path to house - 69→\n    70→    /// Expand a path to include all intermediate grid positions between waypoints\n    71→    private static func expandPath(_ waypoints: [GridPosition]) -> [GridPosition] {\n    72→        guard waypoints.count >= 2 else { return waypoints }\n    73→\n    74→        var expandedPath: [GridPosition] = [waypoints[0]]\n    75→\n    76→        for i in 1..<waypoints.count {\n    77→            let start = waypoints[i - 1]\n    78→            let end = waypoints[i]\n    79→\n    80→            // Calculate deltas\n    81→            let dx = end.x - start.x\n    82→            let dy = end.y - start.y\n    83→\n    84→            // Calculate number of steps needed (max of abs deltas)\n    85→            let steps = max(abs(dx), abs(dy))\n    86→\n    87→            if steps == 0 { continue }\n    88→\n    89→            // Add all intermediate positions\n    90→            for step in 1...steps {\n    91→                let x = start.x + (dx * step) / steps\n    92→                let y = start.y + (dy * step) / steps\n    93→                let position = GridPosition(x: x, y: y)\n    94→\n    95→                // Avoid duplicates\n    96→                if position != expandedPath.last {\n    97→                    expandedPath.append(position)\n    98→                }\n    99→            }\n   100→        }\n   101→\n   102→        return expandedPath\n   103→ public override func update(_ currentTime: TimeInterval) {\n   334→        let deltaTime = lastUpdateTime == 0 ? 0 : currentTime - lastUpdateTime\n   335→        lastUpdateTime = currentTime\n   336→\n   337→        // Skip updates if game is paused\n   338→        if hud.isGamePaused {\n   339→            showPauseOverlay()\n   340→            return\n   341→        } else {\n   342→            hidePauseOverlay()\n   343→        }\n   344→\n   345→        // Apply game speed multiplier\n   346→        let adjustedDeltaTime = deltaTime * TimeInterval(hud.gameSpeed)\n   347→\n   348→        // Update ability manager cooldowns\n   349→        abilityManager.update(deltaTime: deltaTime)\n   350→\n   351→        switch gameState.currentState {\n   352→        case .building:\n   353→            updateBuildingPhase(deltaTime: adjustedDeltaTime)\n   354→        case .wave:\n   355→            updateWavePhase(deltaTime: adjustedDeltaTime)\n   356→        case .gameOver:\n   357→            handleGameOver()\n   358→        case .victory:\n   359→            handleVictory()\n   360→        default:\n   361→            break\n   362→        }\n   363→    }\n   364→\n   365→    private func updateBuildingPhase(deltaTime: TimeInterval) {\n   366→        buildPhaseTimer += deltaTime\n   367→\n   368→        // Use shorter delay if auto-start is enabled (3 seconds), otherwise use full time (20 seconds)\n   369→        let autoStartDelay: TimeInterval = 3.0\n   370→        let waveStartTime = hud.isAutoStartEnabled ? autoStartDelay : GameConfiguration.timeBetweenWaves\n   371→\n   372→        let timeRemaining = max(0, waveStartTime - buildPhaseTimer)\n   373→        hud.updateBuildTimer(timeRemaining)\n   374→\n   375→        // Auto-start wave if timer expires\n   376→        if buildPhaseTimer >= waveStartTime {\n   377→            startWave()\n   378→        }\n   379→\n   380→        // Apply auto-repair\n   381→        applyAutoRepair(deltaTime: deltaTime)\n   382→    }\n   383→\n   384→    private func updateWavePhase(deltaTime: TimeInterval) {\n   385→        // Update wave manager\n   386→        waveManager.update(deltaTime: deltaTime, activeBugs: bugs.count)\n   387→\n   388→        // Update bugs\n   389→        var bugsToRemove: [Bug] = []\n   390→        for bug in bugs {\n   391→            bug.update(deltaTime: deltaTime, pathfindingGrid: pathfindingGrid)\n   392→\n   393→            // Check if bug reached house\n   394→            if bug.hasReachedHouse() {\n   395→                print(\"💥 Bug reached house! Dealing \\(bug.damage) damage\")\n   396→                gameState.damageHouse(bug.damage)\n   397→                house.takeDamage(bug.damage)\n   398→                bugsToRemove.append(bug)\n   399→            }\n   400→        }\n   401→\n   402→        // Remove bugs that reached house\n   403→        for bug in bugsToRemove {\n   404→            removeBug(bug)\n   405→        }\n   406→\n   407→        // Update structures\n   408→        for structure in structures {\n   409→            structure.update(deltaTime: deltaTime, bugs: bugs)\n   410→        }\n   411→\n   412→        // Update hero\n   413→        hero.update(deltaTime: deltaTime, bugs: bugs)\n   414→\n   415→        // Apply auto-repair during wave\n   416→        applyAutoRepair(deltaTime: deltaTime)\n   417→\n   418→        // Remove dead bugs\n   419→        let deadBugs = bugs.filter { $0.currentHealth <= 0 }\n   420→        for bug in deadBugs {\n   421→            handleBugDeath(bug)\n   422→        }\n   423→    }\n   424→\n   425→    private func applyAutoRepair(deltaTime: TimeInterval) {\n   426→        let totalRepairRate = upgradeManager.totalRepairRate + cardManager.getTotalRepairRate()\n   427→        let repairAmount = Int(CGFloat(totalRepairRate) * CGFloat(deltaTime))\n   428→        if repairAmount > 0 {\n   429→            for structure in structures {\n   430→                structure.repair(repairAmount)\n   431→            }\n   432→        }\n   433→    }\n   434→\n   435→    // MARK: - Wave Management\n   436→\n   437→    public func startWave() {\n   438→        guard gameState.currentState == .building else { return }\n   439→\n   440→        // Apply starting currency bonus from cards\n   441→        let startingBonus = cardManager.getTotalStartingCurrencyBonus()\n   442→        if startingBonus > 0 {\n   443→            gameState.addCurrency(startingBonus)\n   444→        }\n   445→\n   446→        print(\"🌊 Starting wave \\(gameState.currentWave + 1)\")\n   447→\n   448→        // Check if we're entering a new tier\n   449→        let previousTier = TierProgressionManager.shared.getCurrentTier(for: gameState.currentWave)\n   450→\n   451→        gameState.startNextWave()\n   452→\n   453→        // Store old map before updating\n   454→        let previousMap = MapManager.shared.currentMap\n   455→\n   456→        // Update map for current tier (may select new random map every 10 waves)\n   457→        TierProgressionManager.shared.updateMapForWave(gameState.currentWave)\n   458→\n   459→        let newTier = TierProgressionManager.shared.getCurrentTier(for: gameState.currentWave)\n   460→        let newMap = MapManager.shared.currentMap\n   461→\n   462→        // If tier changed, redraw grid and reset towers\n   463→        if previousTier.number != newTier.number {\n   464→            print(\"🏆 Tier transition: \\(previousTier.name) → \\(newTier.name)\")\n   465→            resetAllTowers()\n   466→            redrawGrid()\n   467→        }\n   468→        // If map changed (happens every 10 waves), redraw grid and recalculate paths\n   469→        else if previousMap != newMap {\n   470→            print(\"🗺️ Map changed!
